Site 1 is a short distance from the main trail along a yellow blazed path in a mixed forest, showing regrowth from a 1987 wildfire.
Site 2 is located up a short steep hill on a yellow blazed path to a knob.  This breezy location overlooks the water and is cooler and less buggy in summer.

The parking lot for the backcountry area is located off of Joplin Road near highway mile marker 22 and contains one vault toilet. The hike in campsites are located along a loop trail mostly on ridgetops.
